## Key Production Achievements

- **Serverless AI FinOps Showback Pipeline (AWS + IBM Apptio):** Architected and deployed an automated, Terraform-managed showback pipeline using Python, AWS EventBridge, AWS Lambda, AWS S3 Cross-Account Replication, GitHub Copilot Metrics API, and Splunk API to transmit token usage and seat-level license costs directly to IBM Apptio for enterprise FinOps attribution.
- **Enterprise AI Developer Enablement (200+ Seats):** Led the enterprise rollout, usage governance, model selection policies, and risk guardrails for GitHub Copilot and Amazon Q across 200+ engineers.
- **Golden-Path DevSecOps at Scale (1,200+ Repositories):** Standardized secure CI/CD workflows, secrets management, Terraform IaC, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), and Checkmarx SAST/SCA across a 4-organization, 1,200+ repository enterprise.
- **Internal Developer Platform & Change Automation:** Architected a self-service provisioning portal (React, .NET, Azure SQL) and automated end-to-end change management integrating ServiceNow with CI/CD pipelines and Azure Boards, cutting secure environment onboarding from days to minutes.
- **Observability & Executive Governance:** Engineered AWS CloudWatch and Datadog alerting alongside Power BI executive KPI dashboards, reducing platform MTTR by 50% and surfacing vulnerability trends, license usage, and deployment health.
- **Enterprise Legacy-to-Modern Transformations:** Delivered two end-to-end mainframe modernization initiatives—migrating mission-critical workloads to SAP HANA (2022) and Java (2015)—and captured $600K/year in operational savings via stored-procedure, ETL, and MIPS optimization.

## Core Technical Stack

- **Cloud, Serverless & IaC:** AWS (Lambda, EventBridge, S3 Cross-Account Replication, CloudWatch), Azure DevOps, Terraform, Docker, Hybrid Windows/RHEL Linux Runners
- **AI Enablement & FinOps:** GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, GitHub Copilot Metrics API, IBM Apptio, Splunk API, Power BI
- **DevSecOps & CI/CD:** GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), Azure Pipelines, Checkmarx (SAST/SCA), Secret Scanning, ServiceNow Integration
- **Languages & Data:** Python, C#, .NET, React, TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash, Azure SQL
